claims: Order packed red blood cell transfusion to treat ongoing anemia (Hb 7.7‑8.1 g/dL) and maintain adequate oxygen delivery.
Obtain repeat complete blood count and coagulation panel in 6 hours to monitor trends in hemoglobin, hematocrit, platelets, PT/INR, and fibrinogen.
Continue close hemodynamic monitoring (blood pressure, heart rate, SpO₂) and urine output charting to assess response to therapy and detect any further instability.
